title: deserialize_header custom serde deserializer for 1-2 element constraint — right approach
description: query.rs deserialize_header enforces RFC 8621 §4.4.1 'header must have 1 or 2 elements' at deserialization time. A contributor might suggest moving this to runtime validation in the server handler. That would be wrong: the spec defines a protocol error for 0 or 3+ elements, and catching it at the serde boundary gives a clear error with location context. The current approach is correct and should be kept.
